race.comment: WHO'S IN DEV (3) will be having her first run on this course, and was doing her best work late when finishing third at Launceston 11 days ago. She will be trying to settle a touch closer to the pace here from a superior gate, and if the gaps present themselves at the right time, she can have the last say. SNOW EAGLE (4) was a well beaten fourth in a 4-horse field at Launceston when resuming from a spell a month ago. She has trialled again since then and her best for has all been on this circuit. She is worth another chance at some value. SNOWDONIA (5) did not see out a strong 1600m last time out, and her form over a trip similar to this before that run is the better guide to use. Stick with her on an each-way basis. BELLA CHINKARA (6) could not make up any ground after settling a long way back from a wide draw 11 days ago at Launceston. A big swing in her draw this time will make a difference, and she is worth top 4 consideration. LAST TREMBLE (10) can run into the top 4 at value.
